Basic Controls:

  • Mouse to move

  • Space to divide

  • W to shoot blobs

Basic Mechanics:

  • Eat blobs smaller than you to grow in size.

  • Use the space bar to send 50% of your mass flying at a blob to eat it.

  • Use the W key to eject some mass.

  • Viruses are the mid sized green 'spikey' blobs which cause blobs larger than them to explode into many smaller parts if they consume them. (at about 150~ mass you can absorb a virus and explode)

  • Small blobs (smaller than size 130~) can hide inside of viruses with no negative effects (use this to your advantage when starting out)

General Guide:

Early Game (<150): Focus on eating blobs and avoid other blobs. Viruses (green spiky things) can hide you under them. Also stay away from corners since it's easy to get trapped there.

Mid Game (150+): Once you're fairly larger than viruses, try to eat other players by forcing them into corners/walls or splitting (Space Bar). Careful with splitting, because if you aren't more than double your prey's size they'll eat you instead :(

Late Game/Leaderboard: Splitting is crucial at this point, as well as extremely risky. It is a terrible idea to split when facing another leaderboarder, but splitting to eat medium-sized blobs is a good way to grow quickly. However, splitting puts you at a big disadvantage until you reform, because another leaderboarder can just eat you. It's also important to note that you move much faster when split into multiple blobs! Try to watch other leaderboarders to see when they split to eat someone else, and then eat their smaller blobs without splitting.

Useful Strategies:

Escape:

Wall-hugging: Moving your mouse past the invisible boundary will cause your blob to squish up against the wall, reducing its size by a considerable amount (about 1/3). This is very useful for escapes since it's much harder to eat a small blob.

Splitting: Spam Space Bar to split into multiple blobs very quickly. This can be a guaranteed escape but leaves you vulnerable after the escape since you're split into bit-sized pieces.

W-spamming (Only use in teams, splitting is more optimal, because as long as you have some blobs after you split, you'll stay alive. W-spamming leaves you with one main blob, and that can get eaten):

If you are trying to run away from someone who can eat you because you're about to be trapped, spam W through the opening to someone else on your team. This will cause you to become smaller and faster, allowing you to get through the gap, and hopefully helping out a teammate instead of that darn green team >:). The best part is, you won't even lose much total mass since you'll just pick 90% of the mass back up! (Ejected mass only gives you back 90% of what you lost)

Attack:

Virus-shooting: Shoot mass at Viruses with w and they'll grow in size. When you hit them 7 times, they split another virus off in whichever direction you were shooting your mass. This splits up the bigger blobs into bite sized pieces.

Cornering: When you get larger, it will become much harder to eat people without splitting.Remember splitting is the best way to get larger quickly, but leaves you vulnerable. When this happens, an easy way to get people is by cornering them against a wall or corner so they can't escape. (Thanks to /u/dis_is_my_account)

Other Mechanics:

  • You can have a skin

  • Every cell experiences a passive loss of mass in relation to their current size (larger cells lose mass much, much faster than smaller cells)

  • Score is simply the largest mass you have had this current life.

  • You must be 25% larger (mass) than another blob to absorb it (that means your diameter must be ~11% larger than another blob to absorb it)

  • Feeding a virus, by using w to eject mass into it, 7 times will cause it to create another virus which will launch out of the current virus and go somewhere from 7 to 12 units in distance.

  • You can try to ally with people by shooting W at them. This is universally recognized as 'let's be friends, don't eat me' :)

  • Ejecting causes you to lose some mass related to your size but the ejected mass only has 90% of what you lost.

  • The maximum number of cells you can be split into is 16.

  • Viruses do not always cause the player to split; there is a cap to how many pieces you can be, which changes quite often and is currently 16, if you are already at this threshold you can simply consume a virus as though it were any other cell.

  • At certain sizes you reach milestones which unlock new abilities (you can choose to display the mass of your cell by selecting "Show Mass" in the options when you name your cell):

  • ▲ Size 32: Eject a blob of size 16 to increase your passive movement speed or feed a virus.

  • ▲ Size 150: Create another virus by feeding an existing virus 7 times.

  • ▲ Size 150: Large enough to explode an existing virus.

  • ▲ Size 1900~: Due to passive loss of mass (about 20/s) it becomes nearly impossible to retain size by eating neutral blobs. (which only contribute a single point of pass each)

  • ▲ Size ~~30,000~~ 22,500: The Maximum Size Limit.
